_about: Completion criteria from the approved proposal → the test that proves each → status. Updated after every verified run. Statuses: pass | fail | pending | manual.

criteria.criterion: A clean clone builds and runs from README steps (npm ci && npm run build && npm run preview), and tests pass
criteria.result: Fresh-agent README walkthrough (2026-10-22, clone of a4598c4 in the scratchpad, Node 22.22.0): npm ci, dev, build, preview, npm test (112 at that commit), npm run e2e (42 passed on a clean port), npm run eval and typecheck all worked the first time. Not tested: Node 20 itself, `npx playwright install` on a bare machine, the live site (no outbound access). It found README gaps: eval dirtied a tracked file, e2e silently reuses a server on 4173, deploy is a force-push. Fixed in the commit after 6a06bb1: eval now writes only with EVAL_VERSION, and the README documents the e2e server, the force-push and PAGES_REPO. Re-verified there: npm test 116 passed, plain eval leaves git clean.

criteria.criterion: Each scam sample: 'Worth a closer look' or 'Likely scam', ≥3 explained highlights, correct playbook; genuine samples not flagged
tests: tests/e2e/journey.spec.ts > each scam sample is flagged…

criteria.criterion: Demo thread: timeline advances; the step-2 prediction matches what the later message does (and step 3 → check, step 4 → pay vendor)
Held-out corpus 2 (written after rule freeze by an agent that never saw rules): recall and precision at 'closer look+' reported publicly; target ≥ 0.85 each
criteria.result: Blind v1.0 (rules blob 5edf666, 2026-10-22): recall 0.85 (34/40), precision 0.944 (2/40 legit flagged, both closer-look; 0 legit likely), script match 28/34. Synthetic corpus; not real-world accuracy.

criteria.criterion: Zero network requests during analysis; CSP forbids connections
axe-core: 0 serious/critical on every screen and state (light + dark); keyboard-only core flow; 390 px and 1440 px
Every edge state renders its designed state without crashing: empty, too short, >20k, non-English, no match, engine timeout, worker failure
Never freezes: ≤300 ms on adversarial 20k inputs; no unbounded wildcards in rules
